value.rationale: The observable is the pre-existing limiting fluctuation law; its endpoint matters for identifying non-Gaussian fine structure. A natural entire-endpoint question is not resolved by evaluating a reciprocal sequence. The uniform theorem distinguishes a genuine factor-two lattice phase, locates its exponentially narrow transition strips at every denominator q, and completely characterizes the set of normalized accumulation values. It is an asymptotic classification, not a routine numerical improvement.
